name: 🐷 Pork Carnitas Tacos
what: Pork slow-cooked all day, shredded and broiled crispy, in warm tortillas.
early: Start the slow cooker in the morning (8 hours on low).

core.name: Orange juice + limes
core.out: just the limes and ½ cup water

extras: cilantro, salsa verde, avocado, cumin, oregano, chili powder

moves.text: Morning: pull the must-haves onto the counter. Cut the pork in 4 chunks and rub with salt and spices.
Onion and garlic in the slow cooker, pork on top, orange juice and lime juice over it. LOW 8 hours.
Dinner: shred the pork in the pot with two forks.
Spread on a sheet pan with a little juice. Broil until the edges crisp. Watch it.
Warm tortillas, set out toppings, build tacos. Save leftovers in some juice.

key: The broil at the end. Crispy edges are what make it carnitas.
done: The pork falls apart with a fork, and after broiling the edges are brown and crispy.
plan_b: Forgot to start it in the morning? Taco night with ground meat instead.
